name: fluid_inclusions
label: Fluid inclusions
description: Extracts microthermometric and host-mineral data of fluid inclusions for each sample or assemblage.
system_prompt: Extract values from a scientific paper. Report only what the paper states.
intro: Extracts microthermometric and host-mineral data of fluid inclusions for each sample or assemblage. For every set (and sample) in the structure plan below, extract the values the paper reports. A value that holds for every set goes in ONE row with `set` ''; one that differs between sets goes in each set's row; one that differs between the samples of a set goes in each sample's row.

parameters.description: Final ice melting temperature (Tm) of fluid inclusions.
Salinity of the fluid inclusions as weight percent NaCl equivalent.
Size or diameter of the fluid inclusions.
Liquid volume fraction of the inclusion at room temperature (0-1 or %, as printed).
Fluid phases in the inclusions (e.g. H2O, CO2, CH4, hydrocarbon).
Mineral hosting the fluid inclusions (e.g. calcite, shocked quartz).
